hypothesis: Consecutive positive revenue YoY growth streak (>=2 consecutive quarters of positive YoY growth as of the 10-Q filing date) may predict positive 10-day forward excess returns for watchlist equity tickers, providing a consistency-of-direction signal distinct from the companyfacts_growth_quality rate-of-growth threshold used in the current FUNDAMENTAL_GROWTH_RS_PAPER sleeve.
change_summary: Probe-only: computed consecutive revenue YoY growth streak (>=2 consecutive positive quarters) across all three canonical windows using data/kova/fundamentals/companyfacts_growth_20260421.jsonl. No code was written or deployed.
nearby_prior_experiments: exp-20260604-002 (sector OHLCV peer earnings shock transfer — rejected)
component: inline probe using companyfacts_growth_20260421.jsonl (observe-only, all three canonical windows)

probe_results.three_window_consistency: FAILS — streak>=2 bucket shows strong lift +6.68pp in old_thin but turns negative in mid_weak (-0.30pp, n=12 thin sample) and late_strong (-0.42pp, n=56). Direction is inconsistent across windows. Mid_weak sample too thin (n=12) to distinguish from noise.

calibration.surprise_note: The old_thin lift (+6.68pp) was stronger than expected, but mid_weak was too thin (n=12) and late_strong reversed (-0.42pp). The regime-dependence failure mode was predicted and realized: consecutive revenue growth streak is a momentum-confirming signal that works in bull markets (old_thin) but not in mean-reversion or uncertainty regimes.

rejection_reason: Consecutive revenue growth streak (>=2 consecutive positive YoY revenue quarters) fails three-window consistency. Lift is +6.68pp in old_thin (n=29) but reverses to -0.30pp in mid_weak (n=12, too thin) and -0.42pp in late_strong (n=56). The signal direction is inconsistent across the canonical windows. Likely mechanism: in AI-cycle bull markets consecutive revenue growth is a momentum confirmation that rewards compounders; in tariff-uncertainty / mean-reversion regimes (late_strong), high-streak tickers are already priced-in and face sell-on-delivery pressure. The mid_weak thin sample (n=12) means that window's sign cannot be trusted even if it appears weakly positive.
next_retry_requires: A multi-year companyfacts sample spanning at least 3 distinct market regimes (the current data covers only ~18 months)
A regime gate that cleanly separates bull-compounding vs mean-reversion environments before entry
Or: a genuinely different operationalization of earnings quality consistency, such as accelerating-growth or beat-vs-estimate consistency rather than raw positive-growth streak
anti_repeat_rule: Do not retry consecutive positive YoY revenue growth streak (>=2 quarters) as a primary candidate-pool source family without a regime gate or a multi-year companyfacts sample spanning at least 3 distinct market regimes. The streak signal is momentum-confirming in bull markets but regime-dependent and inconsistent across the three canonical windows.
notes: Probe-only experiment. No code written, no backtest run. The companyfacts_growth_quality mechanism already captured in FUNDAMENTAL_GROWTH_RS_PAPER uses rate-of-growth thresholds; this tested a direction-consistency variant that failed three-window consistency for the same underlying regime-dependence reason as sector peer earnings transfer (exp-20260604-002).
